author.companyId: The author's company, such as `alibaba` for Qwen.
model.groupIds: Includes parent groups, such as `claude` for a Claude Opus model.
model.openWeights: The author publishes the weights of this model.
model.reasoningMaxTokens.minimum: Smallest reasoning budget in tokens. Missing when the model takes no budget.
deployment.approvalRequired: The provider serves the deployment only to accounts that it has approved.
deployment.retirementDate: The date that the provider names for its shutdown. The gateway serves the deployment until 12:00 UTC on the next day. Missing until the provider announces one.
deployment.reasoningDefault: What a request that sets no reasoning gets: `none`, `enabled` or a reasoning effort. Missing when the provider does not state it.
deployment.reasoningMaxTokens.minimum: Smallest reasoning budget in tokens. Missing when the deployment takes no budget.
deployment.weightPrecision: `fp32`, `bf16`, `fp16`, `fp8`, `fp6`, `fp4`, `nvfp4`, `mxfp4`, `int8` or `int4`, or `unknown` when the provider does not disclose it.
deployment.capabilities.systemMessages: Required by `system` or `developer` messages, or by `instructions` on Responses.
deployment.capabilities.functionCalling: Required by `function` or `custom` tools, or by `functions` on Chat Completions.
deployment.capabilities.toolChoice: Required by a `tool_choice` or `function_call` other than `auto` or `none`.
deployment.capabilities.toolResultAttach: Required by an image or a file in a tool result.
deployment.capabilities.implicitPromptCa: Required by `prompt_cache_retention`. Only deployments with it receive `prompt_cache_key`.
deployment.promptCacheMinimumTokens: Fewest prompt tokens that the provider caches. Missing when the deployment caches no prompts or the provider states no minimum.
deployment.sampling.temperature: The deployment accepts a `temperature` other than its default in at least one reasoning setting. The other `sampling` fields say the same for their parameter.
deployment.inputLimits.requestBytes: Largest request body that the provider accepts, in bytes. Every `inputLimits` field is missing when the provider states no limit.
deployment.inputLimits.images.bytes: Largest image in bytes, before base64 encoding.
deployment.inputLimits.images.totalBytes: Largest sum of all images in bytes, before base64 encoding.
deployment.inputLimits.images.pixels: Longest side of an image in pixels.
deployment.inputLimits.documents.bytes: Largest document in bytes, before base64 encoding.
deployment.inputLimits.documents.totalBy: Largest sum of all documents in bytes, before base64 encoding.
deployment.dataHandling.processingLocati: Where inference can run: a [location value](#location-values).
deployment.dataHandling.processingWithin: `processingLocation` and every place that contains it, such as `['DE', 'eu', 'europe', 'world']` for `DE`.
deployment.dataHandling.storageLocation: Where the provider can keep content at rest: a [location value](#location-values) or `none`.
deployment.dataHandling.storageWithin: `storageLocation` and every place that contains it, or every place for `none`.
deployment.dataHandling.retentionDays: Longest routine retention of content. `0` means none after the response. Missing when unknown.
deployment.dataHandling.trainingUse: The provider can train models on content. Missing when unknown.
deployment.dataHandling.zeroDataRetentio: A zero data retention commitment from the provider covers the offering. Implies storage `none`, retention `0` and no training use.
deployment.dataHandling.endToEndEncrypte: Content stays encrypted from the gateway to the provider's inference workload. Ordinary TLS to a provider endpoint is `false`.
deployment.dataHandling.tee: The provider runs inference inside a trusted execution environment. The provider defines which workloads are accepted there unless `teeVerified` is true.
deployment.dataHandling.teeVerified: Stogas verifies the measured workload itself, without relying on measurements that the provider defines. Implies `tee`.
deployment.dataHandling.isolatedPromptCa: The provider keeps each account's prompt cache apart, so that no other account can learn from cached token counts or response times what this account sent. `false` on every deployment that Stogas managed serves, because all customers share our provider account.
deployment.dataHandling.sharedWith: Each company other than the provider's and the hosting that receives the request, or `unknown` for companies that the provider does not name. Does not list the suppliers that a company runs its service on. Hosted tools add the companies that they send content to.
deployment.dataHandling.certifications: The independent audits and government authorizations that cover the service, such as `soc2-type2`. Empty when the company that runs the model publishes none. Hosted tools remove the entries that do not cover them. See [Certifications](/docs/policies/routing-fields#certifications).
deployment.hosting: The company that runs the model, or `unknown`.
deployment.companies: Each company that receives the request, once: the provider's company, the hosting and each company in `dataHandling.sharedWith`.
deployment.upstream.model: The provider's name for the model.
deployment.upstream.reasoningMode: `pro` on Pro deployments and missing on others.
deployment.upstream.inferenceGeo: Where the model runs. Anthropic: the `inference_geo` that the gateway sends, `global` or `us`. Missing on models older than Claude 4.6, which take none. AWS: `global`, or the geography of a Bedrock inference profile: `us`, `eu`, `jp`, `au`, `in` or `ca`. Only `global` or `us` when Anthropic runs the model. Google Cloud: `global` or `us`, or `eu` when Google runs the model.
deployment.upstream.modelVersion: Azure: the pinned model version, such as `2026-07-09`.
deployment.upstream.gpuCount: Chutes: GPUs assigned to the chute, from 1 to 8. Missing on [Standard models](/docs/providers/chutes#standard-models).
deployment.pricing.input_tokens.per_mill: Input tokens, without cache reads and writes.
deployment.pricing.cached_input_tokens.p: Input tokens read from the provider cache.
deployment.pricing.cache_write_input_tok: Cache writes without a separate price for each duration.
deployment.pricing.reasoning_tokens.per_: Missing when the deployment bills reasoning at the output price.
route.documentFormats.extensions: File extensions that the route reads from documents itself, such as `.pdf`. See [Input files](/docs/input-files).
route.documentFormats.mediaTypes: Media types that the route reads from documents itself, such as `application/pdf`.
provider.companyId: The provider's company, such as `amazon` for AWS.
provider.headquarteredCountry: ISO country code, such as `US`. For where inference runs, see `deployment.dataHandling.processingLocation`.
credential.kind: The [kind of credential](/docs/byok): `managed` for Stogas managed, `stored`, or `encrypted` for customer encrypted.
credential.accountOptions: IDs of the [account options](/docs/byok#account-options) that the credential's account has and that apply to the deployment, such as `zero-data-retention`. Empty for Stogas managed.
credential.declaredAccountOptions: The entries of `credential.accountOptions` that the credential's owner turned on and the provider did not report.
request.model: What the request's `model` field selects, as `kind:ID` terms in the order author, provider, route, model, group, deployment, such as `model:gpt-5.6-sol` or `provider:azure group:gpt-6`. An alias reads as its model ID. Missing when the request has none.
request.time: When the request started. The same value applies to every candidate.
request.bodyBytes: Size of the JSON body as sent, before redaction.
request.hostedTools: The [hosted tools](/docs/model-tools#hosted-tools) that the request lets the model call: `web_search`, `web_fetch` or `mcp`. `mcp` is listed whenever the request has an `mcp` tool. Empty on Chat Completions.
request.clientTools: Names of the `function` and `custom` tools that the request lets the model call.
request.mcpServers: The [remote MCP servers](/docs/model-tools#remote-mcp-servers) that the request lists, whatever `tool_choice` says: the host of a `server_url`, such as `mcp.example.com`, a `connector_id` as `connector:<id>` or a `tunnel_id` as `tunnel:<id>`. All are lowercase. Empty on Chat Completions.
request.mcpServersWithoutApproval: The servers in `request.mcpServers` whose `require_approval` lets a call run [without approval](/docs/model-tools#calls-without-approval): `never`, or a `never` filter.
request.mcpTools: Each tool that `allowed_tools` names on a server in `request.mcpServers`, as the server, a slash and the tool's name, such as `mcp.example.com/search`. A server that names no tools reads as `mcp.example.com/*`.
request.systemMessages: Whether the request sends a `system` or `developer` message, or `instructions`.
